text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh... What do you mean...
we lost?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What just happened...?
My luck didn't work...? Hu... Huhhh?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You're lying, right? This can't be real...
Because there's no way that'd happen. My luck is...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, what is going on?
This has to be a bad dream, right?
I'm asleep right now, aren't I!?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No way...! And here I thought I had been reborn...
At this rate, I'm just the same as before...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Where did all my luck go?! Don't tell me it's hibernating?!
No, that can't be...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Please wake up! Please...
I'm begging you!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If the gods forsake me, I... I...!
Waaahhh...!!

I gently hold back Silence Suzuka, who came running in concern.
Matikanefukukitaru continued to weep non-stop.

Our next goal is—the Takarazuka Kinen.
Even after saying that, there was no reply at all.
